name: Jinet
description: Jinet was an uninhabited planet in the Jinet system of the Brak sector in the Expansion Region. The Alliance to Restore the Republic established a starfighter base on the planet shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The base was home to a squadron of BTL Y-wing starfighters.
lead_paragraphs: Jinet was an uninhabited planet in the Jinet system of the Brak sector in the Expansion Region. The Alliance to Restore the Republic established a starfighter base on the planet shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The base was home to a squadron of BTL Y-wing starfighters.
